question: Two trains, one 390 metres and the other 250 metres long are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks, at the speed of 78 km/hr and 66 km/hr respectively. How much time will they take to cross each other?

Length of two trains 390m and 250m having speed 78km/hr and 66km/hr respectively to find at what time they cross each other.

When two trains run in opposite direction, then their relative speed is the sum of their individual speed.

Distance = Speed × Time
